You will collaborate closely with the pharmacy, nursing, and social work departments to coordinate complex medication approvals and ensure adherence to treatment protocols. The position requires a meticulous approach to data management, utilizing advanced Excel functions and Smartsheet to maintain comprehensive patient tracking logs and generate weekly status reports for clinical leadership. We are implementing a new telehealth platform, and you will be instrumental in training staff on its use and integrating it into the existing clinical workflow. Success in the first six months includes reducing the average prior authorization turnaround time from seven to four business days and improving patient satisfaction scores on access by 12 points. You will be expected to develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of Medicare and private insurance billing rules, ensuring that all documentation supports clean claim submission. The ideal candidate possesses a strong ability to navigate the electronic health record, communicate complex clinical information clearly, and drive operational efficiencies. This role provides a clear pathway to an Administrative Director position, with opportunities to contribute to strategic planning and the expansion of our clinical services. Your leadership will be key in fostering a supportive environment for the patient access staff while ensuring that the department meets its performance and quality goals.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python + React)
raw_text: We are seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Engineer to lead the development of our next-generation customer analytics platform. You will join a 10-person engineering team that builds data-intensive web applications serving thousands of enterprise clients daily. In this role, you will be the technical anchor for a squad of six engineers, driving architectural decisions and ensuring the quality and performance of both backend APIs and frontend interfaces. Your day-to-day responsibilities include designing and implementing robust RESTful and GraphQL APIs using Python with Django 4.2 and Django REST Framework, while also crafting dynamic, responsive user interfaces with React 18 and TypeScript. You will be responsible for optimizing our PostgreSQL 15 database schema and query performance, including implementing indexing strategies and caching layers with Redis. You will lead code reviews, enforce best practices in testing (using PyTest and Jest), and set up continuous integration pipelines with GitHub Actions. A major project for this role is refactoring our legacy authentication system to integrate OAuth2 and improve security posture. You will collaborate closely with product managers to translate feature requirements into technical specifications, and with the QA team to automate end-to-end testing using Selenium. Success in the first six months means delivering a complete redesign of our dashboard module, achieving a 20% improvement in page load time, and reducing critical bugs by 15%. We expect you to mentor junior developers on the team and contribute to our internal technical documentation standards. The ideal candidate has deep experience with cloud deployments on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3) and understands containerization using Docker and orchestration with ECS. This role offers a clear path to Staff Engineer, with opportunities to influence technology stack evolution and participate in cross-team architecture committees. You will work in an agile environment with two-week sprints, participating in planning, retro, and daily standups.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer (Python/React)
raw_text: We are looking for a motivated Junior Full-Stack Developer to join our product engineering team, which builds a scalable e-learning platform for universities and corporate training. You will work within a squad of eight engineers, product designers, and QA analysts, contributing to new feature development and maintenance of existing systems. Your primary responsibilities will involve writing clean, maintainable code for both backend services using Python and Flask, and frontend components using React and JavaScript. You will participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews, learning from senior engineers while gradually taking ownership of small features from design to deployment. You will be expected to write unit tests using PyTest and Jest, and become familiar with our CI/CD pipeline built on GitLab CI. You will collaborate with the product team to understand user stories and translate them into technical solutions, and with the QA team to ensure high test coverage. A key project for your first few months will be implementing a new user notification system, integrating with our existing database (PostgreSQL) and an internal email service. Success in the first six months includes delivering at least three well-tested features independently, demonstrating a strong grasp of our codebase, and contributing to improved documentation. You will also have the opportunity to work with our data team to build dashboards using React. Our tech stack includes Python 3.10, Flask 2.2, React 17, Redux, PostgreSQL 13, and Docker for local development. We provide a supportive environment with mentorship and a clear growth path to mid-level engineer. We value curiosity, a passion for learning, and a solid foundation in web development fundamentals.
